versions.subject: Fix all the rules to pass the test
Refactor regex
versions.detection:
selection:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'reg add'
        - 'hklm\system\currentcontrolset\control'
        - 'write protection'
        - '0'
    CommandLine|contains:   
        - 'storage'
        - 'storagedevicepolicies'
condition: selection
versions.spl: CommandLine="*reg add*" CommandLine="*hklm\\system\\currentcontrolset\\control*" CommandLine="*write protection*" CommandLine="*0*" CommandLine IN ("*storage*", "*storagedevicepolicies*")
